rows.label: tlk42100121_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Takaka has made another
discovery of the century, mo.

rows.label: tlk42100121_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Takaka noticed it while watching
the Driver scout below, mo.

rows.label: tlk42100121_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Sometimes a resonated Blade can hold
an incredible amount of potential, mo.

rows.label: tlk42100121_04_msg0004
rows.name:
I had a feeling such a Blade could be
even stronger than Heaven's Holy Grail
or the Jewel of Superbia, mo.

rows.label: tlk42100121_04_msg0005
rows.name:
At first glance, just an ordinary
Blade, but... Takaka strongly felt
that potential, mo.

rows.label: tlk42100121_04_msg0006
rows.name:
So any Driver who works hard should
meet a Blade like that someday, mo.
